title: Towards transistor-based quantum computing
summary: In this work, we propose and study in depth a universal quantum computing architecture based on a quantum construction of transistors. Our teleportation-based quantum transistors, called ``telesistors'', are ground states of systems with symmetry-protected topological order, hence suppress certain noises and provide high-fidelity Clifford gates without the need for active error correction.
